authored_from: the question text, the tool catalogue descriptions and the golden set's must_mention_tools; not from any planner output
note: required: tools a sound plan for this question must call (recall denominator). allowed: every tool in scope for an execution-quality investigation (precision numerator). The planner sees the question, never the data, so the cases vary the question, not the scenario.

cases.question: Analyse our AAPL execution between 14:00 and 15:00 and explain why implementation shortfall changed.
Was the AAPL slippage this hour caused by a slow order gateway or a recent deployment?
Did one venue underperform on our AAPL fills between 14:00 and 15:00?
Were AAPL spreads or volatility unusual this hour compared with the hour before?
Was the AAPL order book thin while our VWAP order was working?
Was our AAPL parent order too large for the market this afternoon?
Check whether bad quotes or a market-data feed problem hurt our AAPL execution.
Does the AAPL deterioration need a written explanation under the execution policy? Cite the policy.
Explain the AAPL VWAP slippage and whether the algorithm configuration changed.
Were AAPL child orders rejected or slow to be acknowledged, and why?
